Build it

Fact Family House

The three numbers on the roof live in this house. Write the 2 multiplication facts and 2 division facts that use them, then press Check.

Some fact families have only 2 facts. The fact family for 2, 2 and 4 is 2 × 2 = 4 and 4 ÷ 2 = 2.
